description: Puts every thread that is waiting on you, from all projects, at the top of the bb sidebar. Questions and approvals, errors, and finished-but-unread threads share one block, each marked ?, ! or ✓. Running threads get their own block below it, and everything else sits in collapsible project folders with project avatars instead of provider icons. Block titles and labels are in Russian; the plugin is frontend-only and needs no external service.
